name: comment-diet
description: Puts your comments on a diet: one line, or none. A PostToolUse hook (with a Stop backstop) blocks multi-line comment blocks, banners, narration, and road-not-taken comments in .tf/.yml/.yaml/.sh/.py the moment an agent writes them, scoped to the current change so pre-existing comments never trip. Ships a writing-comments skill so comments come out lean in the first place, and a /comment-diet:audit command to clean up files that predate the plugin. Configure thresholds, patterns, and excludes in .comment-diet.json. No dependencies.
